summary: The prepared main snapshot already contains the issue-specific M-RoPE correction: the Qwen3.5 fused QK RMSNorm/RoPE path supplies a per-lane axis map and the Triton kernel reads the corresponding row from [3, T] positions. On gfx950, the current path matched the independent native MRotaryEmbedding reference within BF16 tolerance (max abs 0.03125), while the reproduced legacy temporal-row-only behavior diverged by 5.875. No source correction was duplicated; this PR records evidence and a deterministic regression probe.

tests.what_was_measured: Unmodified gfx950 kernel suite: contract-only test passed, but numerical cases could not compile because the CUDA PDL probe enabled griddepcontrol.launch_dependents on ROCm. Raw compiler evidence is retained; this is separate from the reported CUDA serving bug.

tests.command: Import the kernel module, set _ENABLE_PDL=False for the ROCm test process, then pytest -q test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/test_fused_qk_rmsnorm_rope_gate.py
tests.what_was_measured: Three tests and five subtests passed on gfx950, covering 1D positions, distinct-axis M-RoPE, interleaved and sectioned layouts, non-contiguous row stride, a full rotary dimension, gate copying, and invalid position/map pairings.

On AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950, current fused M-RoPE versus native reference max abs was 0.03125; legacy temporal-only versus native was 5.875; equal-axis [3,T] versus 1D was exactly 0.0. Positions used shape [3,17] and stride [68,1].

gpu_execution_evidence: Raw logs identify AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, and contain compiled-kernel numerical outputs from the assigned single GPU.
remaining_limitations: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B and Tencent/UI-Mate-27B weights were unavailable; full-model click-coordinate accuracy was not reproduced locally.
The source issue is a CUDA fused-path defect, while the assigned device is AMD gfx950. Local validation therefore establishes the corrected kernel arithmetic, not an NVIDIA H200 serving reproduction.
The unmodified direct kernel test is blocked on ROCm by a separate CUDA-PDL feature-detection defect; PDL was disabled only inside the issue-specific numerical test process.
No Transformers or vLLM full-model semantic comparison was run, and no claim is made for UI-Mate-27B.
